# Submit an image-engine job

Queues a job program on the image engine for a prepared record.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x603185eb` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Arguments: job number, 1, packet, 16. The worker then marks the packet done (2) or failed (3). A bridge checks every record first.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Arguments and completion codes read from the submit path. Source: [E-M5 III image engine (technical notes)](../sources/em5n.image-engine.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): OM-5 jobs 11 and 12 submitted this way run on the E-M5 III and give correct results. Source: [Live ND on the E-M5 III](../sources/em5n.live-nd.md).
